search_observations.channel: exact residual-family search across official registries, repositories, product documentation, and primary implementation sources
search_observations.query: implementation information decomposition; expected value of perfect implementation (EVPIM); expected value of specific implementation (EVSIM); expected value of expanded implementation (EVEIm; proposed terminology candidate); expected value of sample expanded implementation (EVSEIm; proposed terminology candidate); realizable EVPI; implementation-adjusted EVSI (IA-EVSI); expected value of perfection (EVP)
search_observations.limitations: The query names every requested submethod: expected value of perfect implementation (EVPIM), expected value of specific implementation (EVSIM), expected value of expanded implementation (EVEIm), expected value of sample expanded implementation (EVSEIm), realizable EVPI, implementation-adjusted EVSI (IA-EVSI), and expected value of perfection (EVP). The literature defines EVPIM/EVSIM, but paper equations are not treated as software evidence. Public GitHub search and the already inventoried VOI package establish only adjacent general EVPI/EVSI coverage; proprietary tools, unpublished scripts, and terminology variants may be missed.

search_observations.channel: exact residual-family search across official registries, repositories, product documentation, and primary implementation sources
search_observations.query: uncertainty modelling value; EVIU; EEV; VSS; wait-and-see; DVSS; VMS
search_observations.limitations: The query names every requested submethod: EVIU, EEV, VSS, wait-and-see, DVSS, and VMS. The official GAMS aircraft-allocation example explicitly calculates a here-and-now solution, expected value of the EV solution (EEV-style evaluation), wait-and-see, EVPI, and VSS. It does not establish built-in named EVIU, DVSS, or VMS reports, and its metrics are example-model calculations rather than a general-purpose VOI API.

search_observations.channel: exact residual-family search across official registries, repositories, product documentation, and primary implementation sources
search_observations.query: risk adjusted information pricing; EUI; CEI; BPI; SPI; constructed-scale price
search_observations.limitations: The query names every requested submethod: EUI, CEI, BPI, SPI, and constructed-scale price. The consulted primary papers define the measures and the public PrecisionTree material discusses certainty equivalents, but no inspected product source or official documentation exposed calculation of information-specific EUI, CEI, BPI, SPI, or constructed-scale prices. General expected-utility or EVPI facilities are not inferred to implement those estimands.

search_observations.channel: exact residual-family search across official registries, repositories, product documentation, and primary implementation sources
search_observations.query: event localized information value; perfect event information; imperfect event information; tail-event information; information density
search_observations.limitations: The query names every requested submethod: perfect event information, imperfect event information, tail-event information, and information density. The Decision Analysis papers supply method definitions only; no inspected official repository, registry entry, or product documentation exposed an event-localized/tail-event estimator or an information-density diagnostic. Existing general EVPI/EVSI software is therefore recorded only as adjacent coverage.

search_observations.channel: exact residual-family search across official registries, repositories, product documentation, and primary implementation sources
search_observations.query: belief state sequential information value; POMDP observation VOI; myopic sensing value; nonmyopic sensing value; active adaptive management; dual control
search_observations.limitations: POMDPs.jl documents an interface for modelling, solving and simulating POMDPs, not a named VOI estimand. SBO_AIPPMS implements nonmyopic adaptive informative sensing as a belief-MDP application, but its public repository does not label a general POMDP-observation VOI, myopic-sensing value, dual-control value, or active-adaptive-management VOI estimator.

search_observations.channel: exact residual-family search across official registries, repositories, product documentation, and primary implementation sources
search_observations.query: signed social information value; negative or harmful information; information avoidance; information overvaluation; private versus social value; team information sharing
search_observations.limitations: The direct VOI package search exposed conventional non-negative EVPI/EVPPI/EVSI tooling, not an implementation documented for any of the five signed or social submethods. Literature hits were not counted as software evidence.

search_observations.channel: exact residual-family search across official registries, repositories, product documentation, and primary implementation sources
search_observations.query: heterogeneity value decomposition; static value of heterogeneity; dynamic value of heterogeneity
search_observations.limitations: heemod documents heterogeneity/demographic analysis and voi documents EVSI/EVPPI/EVPI, but neither reviewed public product surface documents the static or dynamic value-of-heterogeneity decomposition. The Espinoza et al. paper establishes terminology only.

search_observations.channel: exact residual-family search across official registries, repositories, product documentation, and primary implementation sources
